'''Omphalos'''<ref name="The Comics Companion">''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]''</ref> was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] teeming with a number of different living organisms. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] attempted to [[Mission to Omphalos|test]] the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] known as the [[Planet Killer]] on Omphalos. However, [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] was able to disable the Planet Killer before the superweapon could be activated.<ref name="Run Mace Run" />
